newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: JC-MPH sells 39 mln Boustead plc shares.
newsitem.headline: JC-MPH sells 39 mln Boustead plc shares.

text.p: Singapore's Jack Chia-MPH Ltd (JC-MPH) said on Thursday it had agreed to sell 39.3 million shares in Boustead plc to Diamond Ace Ltd (DAL) for 21.75 pence each.
JC-MPH said in a statement that DAL would buy 19.76 million shares and place out the remaining shares to financial institutions and companies.

It said the sale was subject to Boustead's shareholders approving its purchase of Sunlink Ltd and The Precast Piling and Engineering Co Ltd. Confirmation was also needed that there was no requirement to make a takeover offer for Boustead.
The sale of Boustead shares was expected to take place before June 21. JC-MPH would still own two million Boustead shares after the sale, the statement said.
It said the transaction was not expected to have a significant impact on the net tangible asset and earnings per share of JC-MPH for the financial year ending March 31, 1998.
